AWRD.name: Award
AWRD.definition: Direct or payment related award on a loyalty account. Award alone, award associated to a payment (may be with an additional award alone), award because of  a payment resulting on rebates.

AWRR.name: Award Refund
AWRR.definition: Refund of a loyalty award transaction.

REBR.name: Rebate Refund
REBR.definition: Refund of a loyalty rebate transaction.

REBA.name: Rebate
REBA.definition: Rebate on a total amount, sale item amount, or sale items.

REDR.name: Redemption Refund
REDR.definition: Refund of a loyalty redemption transaction.
